In *Legion of Valkyrie*, War Maidens are not merely numerical tools, but "partners" with souls, attitudes, and stories.

Based on high-quality art and Live2D technology, each War Maiden can showcase her distinct personality through dynamic expressions, delicate movements, and multiple cutscenes.

The War Maidens come from different civilizations: there are kingdom girls who protect their land with chivalry, and pure-blooded elves dwelling in the forest; there are dragon-blooded warriors who wield dragonfire, and automatons from an ancient civilization. Their cultures, beliefs, and destinies intertwine, forming the most vibrant tapestry of life on this continent. Each of them has an independent storyline, each possesses a unique fighting style, and every choice you make can rewrite their fate.

During your adventure, players can gradually unlock the War Maidens' exclusive storylines, continuously strengthening their bonds through dialogue, interaction, and battle.

As affinity grows, the War Maidens will reveal more facets of themselves—shyness, pride, stubbornness, coquettishness, and even the vulnerability hidden behind their strength.

They will change because of your choices, and they will open their hearts to you. This sense of growth and companionship makes every encounter meaningful.

Whether it's the initial wariness as they grip their weapons upon first meeting you, the trust gradually built after battles, or even the rare whispered conversations under the moonlight, these moments are fully captured by Live2D technology, making each War Maiden feel as if they truly exist beside you.

Sexy Skin System: Swimsuits, Lingerie, Uniforms—a complete range of styles are available.

Beyond the adventurous journey, *War Maiden Legion* also brings the essential "collecting pleasure" to players who love their characters.

The game offers an extremely extensive skin system, covering various themes from revealing swimsuits to alluring lingerie, from elegant dresses to playful uniforms, allowing each War Maiden to present herself to you in a different style.

The **Summer Swimsuit Series** uses bright, cheerful colors and water droplet effects to showcase the freest side of the girls;

The **Sexy Series Skins** create an alluring atmosphere with details such as silk textures, black stockings, high heels, and lace;

The **Uniform Theme** includes classic anime-style outfits beloved by players, such as maid, nurse, school uniform, and secretary attire, allowing each battle maiden to display new charm in different roles;

During limited-time holiday events, you can also obtain limited-edition appearances such as **Christmas dresses, New Year's kimono outfits, and Halloween-themed skins**.

Skins are not simply outfit changes; they often come with:

* New Live2D animations

* Different emotions and expressions

* Unique voice lines

* Exclusive interactive dialogue

Some rare skins also bring changes to combat effects

From gentle to dashing, from cute to mature, from pure to alluring, each skin is like rewriting a "character chapter" for the battle maidens.

For collectors, this is not only a place to develop their combat power, but also their own "Valkyrie Costume Library," where they can experience the diverse charm of these characters in various styles.

*Legion of Valkyrie*: When fate breaks, the Valkyries will rewrite the world with you.

*Legion of Valkyrie* is a fantasy RPG that blends collecting beautiful female characters, strategic card battles, open-world exploration, and a deep character development system. With high-quality art as its core selling point, all Valkyries feature exquisite illustrations and Live2D dynamic animations. Some are lively and cute, some are aloof and noble, some are alluring and dangerous, and some are calm and wise.

During your adventure, you can build deep bonds with them, unlock exclusive stories and voice lines, and gradually uncover the secrets hidden deep within their hearts.

If you love the following games, you'll find your home here: Azur Lane, NIKKE: Goddess of Victory, Honkai Impact 3, Genshin Impact, Girls' Frontline, Fate/Grand Order, Arknights. If these titles have captivated you, then *Legion of Valkyrie* will be your new stronghold.

It combines strategy, adventure, beautiful girls, fan service, character development, and character collection to create an immersive fantasy experience.

Conclusion: Your destiny will be inextricably linked with the War Maidens.

On this continent where beauty and danger coexist, you are not a bystander, but a participant.

Legion of Valkyrie await you, trust you, and rely on you, and ultimately, the one who changes the fate of the world—can only be you.

Now, embark on your journey.

Legion of Valkyrie is ready to welcome you.
